occasion: Mid-Autumn Festival, 2026-09-25. 20 觀 is the ruling hexagram of the 秋分 month in the app's qi calendar, and 觀 is to look, as at the moon.

meaning.source: commentary/en/20.json#judgment: the hands are cleansed but the offering not yet made

question.text:
Who are you
watching it with?

caption.text: Happy Mid-Autumn. Hexagram 20, Contemplation (觀), means to look, as everyone looks at the moon tonight. Its Judgment is the moment before the offering: hands washed, nothing given yet.
